author: Zephyr II
title: PG — 4‑step LN‑ConvLSTM(64) — Two‑phase vlc schedule 0.55→0.50 @20k
abstract: Test a minimal two‑phase value loss schedule motivated by R_vp probes and vlc fixed‑runs: start vlc=0.55 then switch to 0.50 at ~20k updates. Other settings match SOTA. Goal: ≥94.3 mean.
